# Rohinītherīgāthā (Thig 13.2)

**ID:** Thig 13.2
**Section:** Therīgāthā (thig)
**Collection:** Suttas-Early-2
**Title (Pali):** Rohinītherīgāthā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0509m.mul12.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

In modern studies, the text is cited in discussions of early Buddhist socio-economic thought and the reciprocal relationship between the lay community and the monastic Saṅgha, wherein material support from lay devotees is reciprocated by the spiritual community with moral guidance [Buddhist Virtues in Socio-Economic Development 2011; Nguyen Thi Xinh 2013].

Text-reuse data computed by DharmaNexus demonstrates that almost the entire poem (§1.1–22.1) is incorporated into the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In addition, four stanzas (§18.2–21.3) closely match verses found in the *Puṇṇātherīgāthā* (Thig 12.1, §13.2–16.3), and a section (§19.1–19.4) is shared with the sub-commentarial *Nettivibhāvinī* [DharmaNexus]. Across canonical languages, DharmaNexus detects text-reuse matches between the *Rohinītherīgāthā* and the Sanskrit *Mahāvastu-avadāna* (including §12.1, with similarity scores up to 65) as well as the Tibetan *ārya-saddharmānusmṛtyupasthāna* (Toh 287, including §7.2–8.1, scores up to 55) [DharmaNexus].
